current_fact_texts.A1: [A1] Each phase's fixed-tag local C2 energy representation has the degree-one homogeneity stated in the Statement. This may be an independent local constitutive hypothesis or the supplied common-law bulk subclass of [[pthm-td-euler-and-gibbs-duhem]] under its exact inverse-chart and reference conventions. The general tagged-scaling postulate alone does not supply it.
current_fact_texts.A2: [A2] The admitted reversible conversion and its reverse are records of the complete finite isolated compound with aggregate equilibrium endpoints represented by full constituent and auxiliary state tuples. Its components include the converted phases, the ideal thermal reservoir at fixed $T$, and every work store or auxiliary, with an adopted additive total endpoint entropy map $S_{\mathrm{tot}}$. Each other component has zero endpoint entropy change, and the reservoir contributes $-Q/T$ when heat $Q$ is absorbed by the system. The reverse record interchanges the two full endpoint tuples and reverses the signed transfer, as required by [[def-td-reversible-process]]. Adopt explicitly $\Delta S_{\mathrm{tot}}[P]\ge0$ and $\Delta S_{\mathrm{tot}}[P^{\mathrm{rev}}]\ge0$ for these two records. Since their entropy changes are negatives, $\Delta S_{\mathrm{tot}}[P]=0$. The postulate [[post-td-macroscopic-second-law]] supplies these inequalities when its admitted core-record, complete endpoint-association and additive-split hypotheses hold; without that additional discharge, the two inequalities are separate adopted model premises of this latent-heat clause. No entropy premise is needed for the slope-only clause.

current_fact_texts.F2: [F2] [[def-td-legendre-potentials]]: on its valid local natural-variable chart, $G=U-Ts+pV$.
current_fact_texts.F3: [F3] [[pthm-td-intensive-coexistence-conditions]]: at an attained entropy maximum, pure pairwise energy, volume, and species transfers with feasible nonzero increments approaching zero from each sign, and every nonselected phase and auxiliary coordinate fixed, give equal positive temperatures, equal pressures, and equal chemical potentials. The Statement supplies exactly these transfer hypotheses.
current_fact_texts.F4: [F4] [[pthm-td-potential-differentials]]: Its current carrier is published and includes verification evidence. On a valid local $C^2$ energy-representation chart with the stated natural-coordinate inverse charts, its Statement gives $dG=-S\,dT+V\,dp+\sum_j\mu_j\,dn_j$. Its Proof derives this identity from the local energy conjugate identities, the Legendre-potential definitions, and the published $C^2$ partial-Legendre differential lemma; it does not assert that heat or work is an exact differential on process space.
current_fact_texts.F5: [F5] [[pthm-td-euler-and-gibbs-duhem]]: if the same-tag homogeneity [A1] holds on a valid local C2 energy chart, its current Statement gives $U=Ts-pV+\mu n$, hence $G/n=\mu$.
